title: Remove concrete domain-plugin assumptions from Host routing and bundle delivery
summary: Make first-party plugin discovery, compilation, bundle manifests, and runtime preparation generic over every declaration-only plugin under plugins/, with no default or required domain plugin.

platform: generic plugin discovery and input matching
runtime preparation and installation of listed artifacts
plugin: declaration source under its own plugins/<name> directory
business identity, checks, dimensions, guidance, and cases
provider: source capability registration and typed snapshots
agent: clarification when multiple installed plugins match a target

forbiddenResponsibilities: Host default selection of a named domain plugin
ordinary plugin Python or registration entry point
compatibility alias for removed concrete-plugin assumptions

humanApproval.decision: Approved as the hard-cut removal of concrete plugin assumptions from platform routing and product delivery.
